Rivals of Aether is one of the best platform fighters I’ve played outside of Smash. It takes the core idea of that style of game and adds its own unique mechanics that make it stand out.

The gameplay is fast, smooth, and very skill-based. Movement feels great, and the lack of traditional shields puts more focus on positioning and timing, which makes matches feel more competitive.

Each character is unique and built around elemental themes, which gives the roster a lot of personality. Learning different characters feels rewarding, and there’s a good amount of depth for players who want to improve.

Another big highlight is the workshop support on PC. The community-made characters and content add a ton of replay value and keep the game feeling fresh.

Overall, Rivals of Aether is a fantastic platform fighter with strong mechanics and a lot of depth. It’s a great alternative for anyone looking for something similar to Smash but with its own identity.
